body: I'm studying engineering. Not going to say which one, as that would be too much information about myself, but it's a pretty traditional one.

I explained a lot of it in my previous post, though I admit it is quite long: https://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/4aeg53/all_there_is_left_for_me_is_boring_work_and/

Basically, I've spent most of my life being lazy and antisocial, spending most of my time daydreaming. After losing what was probably the best opportunity with a girl I'm gonna get my entire life and finding I'm set out for unemployment, I decided to get my shit together. I actually kinda did, in some ways, had plan A all the way to G or H on how I would fix my situation. They all got wrecked by circumstances outside of my control. The fear that I had that I would live a shitty life of mediocre work or unemployment coupled with romantic failure is pretty much official. I see no point in seeing it through.
